title: Road to Cinema
statementMd:
Vasya is currently at a car rental service, and he wants to reach cinema. The film he has bought a ticket for starts in $*t*$ minutes. There is a straight road of length $*s*$ from the service to the cinema. Let's introduce a coordinate system so that the car rental service is at the point $0$, and the cinema is at the point $*s*$.

There are $*k*$ gas stations along the road, and at each of them you can fill a car with any amount of fuel for free! Consider that this operation doesn't take any time, i.e. is carried out instantly.

There are $*n*$ cars in the rental service, $*i*$-th of them is characterized with two integers $*c*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$ — the price of this car rent and the capacity of its fuel tank in liters. It's not allowed to fuel a car with more fuel than its tank capacity $*v*_{*i*}$. All cars are completely fueled at the car rental service.

Each of the cars can be driven in one of two speed modes: normal or accelerated. In the normal mode a car covers $1$ kilometer in $2$ minutes, and consumes $1$ liter of fuel. In the accelerated mode a car covers $1$ kilometer in $1$ minutes, but consumes $2$ liters of fuel. The driving mode can be changed at any moment and any number of times.

Your task is to choose a car with minimum price such that Vasya can reach the cinema before the show starts, i.e. not later than in $*t*$ minutes. Assume that all cars are completely fueled initially.

## Input

The first line contains four positive integers $*n*$, $*k*$, $*s*$ and $*t*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 2·10^{5}$, $2 ≤ *s* ≤ 10^{9}$, $1 ≤ *t* ≤ 2·10^{9}$) — the number of cars at the car rental service, the number of gas stations along the road, the length of the road and the time in which the film starts.

Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains two positive integers $*c*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the price of the $*i*$-th car and its fuel tank capacity.

The next line contains $*k*$ **distinct** integers $*g*_{1}, *g*_{2}, ..., *g*_{*k*}$ ($1 ≤ *g*_{*i*} ≤ *s* - 1$) — the positions of the gas stations on the road in arbitrary order.

## Output

Print the minimum rent price of an appropriate car, i.e. such car that Vasya will be able to reach the cinema before the film starts (not later than in $*t*$ minutes). If there is no appropriate car, print `-1`.

## Note

In the first sample, Vasya can reach the cinema in time using the first or the third cars, but it would be cheaper to choose the first one. Its price is equal to $10$, and the capacity of its fuel tank is $8$. Then Vasya can drive to the first gas station in the accelerated mode in $3$ minutes, spending $6$ liters of fuel. After that he can full the tank and cover $2$ kilometers in the normal mode in $4$ minutes, spending $2$ liters of fuel. Finally, he drives in the accelerated mode covering the remaining $3$ kilometers in $3$ minutes and spending $6$ liters of fuel.
statementZhMd:
Vasya 目前在一家汽车租赁服务处，他想前往电影院。他购买了电影票，电影将在 $*t*$ 分钟后开始。从租赁服务处到电影院有一条长度为 $*s*$ 的笔直道路。建立一个坐标系，使汽车租赁服务处位于点 $0$，电影院位于点 $*s*$。

道路沿线有 $*k*$ 个加油站，在每个加油站都可以免费为汽车加任意量的燃料！认为这一操作不需要任何时间，即可以瞬间完成。

租赁服务处有 $*n*$ 辆汽车，第 $*i*$ 辆汽车由两个整数 $*c*_{*i*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}$ 表示——租用该车的价格以及其油箱容量（单位：升）。不允许向汽车中加入超过油箱容量 $*v*_{*i*}$ 的燃料。所有汽车在租赁服务处时都已加满油。

每辆汽车都可以选择两种速度模式之一驾驶：普通模式或加速模式。在普通模式下，汽车行驶 1 千米需要 2 分钟，并消耗 1 升燃料。在加速模式下，汽车行驶 1 千米需要 1 分钟，但消耗 2 升燃料。可以在任意时刻、任意次数地改变驾驶模式。

你的任务是选择价格最低的汽车，使 Vasya 能够在电影开始前到达电影院，即用时不超过 $*t*$ 分钟。假设所有汽车最初都已加满油。

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个正整数 $*n*$、$*k*$、$*s*$ 和 $*t*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 2·10^{5}$，$2 ≤ *s* ≤ 10^{9}$，$1 ≤ *t* ≤ 2·10^{9}$）——租赁服务处的汽车数量、道路沿线加油站的数量、道路长度以及电影开始前的时间。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个正整数 $*c*_{*i*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——第 $*i*$ 辆汽车的租用价格及其油箱容量。

下一行包含 $*k*$ 个**互不相同**的整数 $*g*_{1}, *g*_{2}, ..., *g*_{*k*$}（$1 ≤ *g*_{*i*} ≤ *s* - 1$）——道路上加油站的位置，顺序任意。

## 输出格式

输出满足条件的汽车中的最低租用价格，即 Vasya 能够在电影开始前（用时不超过 $*t*$ 分钟）到达电影院的汽车价格。如果不存在满足条件的汽车，输出 `-1`。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Vasya 可以使用第一辆或第三辆汽车及时到达电影院，但选择第一辆汽车租用会更便宜。其价格为 $10$，油箱容量为 $8$。随后，Vasya 可以使用加速模式，在 3 分钟内行驶到第一个加油站，消耗 6 升燃料。然后他可以将油箱加满，并使用普通模式行驶 2 千米，用时 4 分钟，消耗 2 升燃料。最后，他使用加速模式行驶剩余的 3 千米，用时 3 分钟，消耗 6 升燃料。
